Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class SparsityForcedConstraint

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.SparsityForcedConstraint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constraint, Jacobian
public final class SparsityForcedConstraint extends Object implements Constraint, Jacobian
Decorator that wraps a Constraint + Jacobian source and forces the jacEq / jacIneq return values to a specific sparsity. Used by MinimizeTrustConstr.minimizeTrustConstr(java.util.function.ToDoubleBiFunction<de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, java.lang.Object>, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, java.lang.Object, java.util.function.BiFunction<de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, java.lang.Object, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix>, java.util.function.BiFunction<de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, java.lang.Object, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix>, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.HessianProduct, de.labathome.trustconstr.records.Bounds, java.lang.Object, double, double, double, java.util.Optional<java.lang.Boolean>, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.IterationCallback, int, int, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, double, double, double, double, de.labathome.trustconstr.enums.ProjectionMethod, boolean) to honor the user-supplied sparseJacobian preference (mirrors scipy's sparse_jacobian=True/False argument): when explicitly set, callers can override the auto-detected representation.

constrEq / constrIneq pass through unchanged (constraint values are 1-D and sparsity is rarely meaningful for them). lagrangianContribution, nEq(), nIneq(), keepFeasible-related delegates, and validateKeepFeasibleAtStart pass through to the source as well.
